meta.title: Rakhal — Smart Dairy Management, From Cattle to Profit
meta.description: Track cattle, milk, health, reproduction, expenses, and farm growth from one powerful dashboard. Built for dairy farms in Bangladesh.

hero.title: Smart Dairy Management, From Cattle to Profit
hero.subtitle: Track cattle, milk, health, reproduction, expenses, and farm growth from one powerful dashboard.

counters.title: Trusted by dairy farms across Bangladesh

problem.title: Notebooks can't run a modern dairy farm
problem.p1: Most dairy farms still depend on notebooks, memory, scattered spreadsheets, and verbal updates.
problem.p2: That makes it hard to know which cow is producing less milk, which animal needs treatment, which cow is pregnant, how much profit the farm is making — and where money is being lost.
problem.paper1: Cow #12 — how much milk? Check the notebook…
problem.solutionCardBody: Every record, in one place — always at hand.

solution.title: Your entire farm, in one smart dashboard
solution.body: From cattle profiles to milk records, reproduction, health, expenses, and reports — Rakhal helps you make better decisions every day.

features.title: Everything a dairy farm needs
features.subtitle: Purpose-built modules that work together — one system instead of notebooks.
features.f1Desc: Every animal gets a full profile: breed, weight, status, photos, and complete history.
features.f2Desc: Log every session in seconds — and watch daily, weekly, and monthly trends.
features.f3Desc: Report sickness, manage treatments — and never miss a vaccine dose again.
features.f4Desc: Heat, insemination, pregnancy checks, and calving — tracked on time, every time.
features.f5Desc: Record income and expenses, and see exactly where your money goes.
features.f6Desc: Download clear reports on production, health, and finances in one click.
features.f7Desc: Simple screens and Bangla-first design your whole team can use.

steps.title: Get started in minutes — no complicated setup
steps.s1Desc: Sign up and set up your farm profile in a few taps.
steps.s2Desc: Add your animals one by one — or all at once with CSV.
steps.s3Desc: Log milk, health, and reproduction events every day.
steps.s4Desc: Every farm number at a glance — anytime, from anywhere.

dashboard.title: A dashboard that runs your whole farm
dashboard.subtitle: Every number that matters — on one screen.

testimonials.title: Farmers already run smarter with Rakhal
testimonials.q1: Before Rakhal, we used notebooks for everything. Now I can see cattle records, milk production, and health updates from one dashboard.
testimonials.q2: Rakhal helped us understand which cows are performing well and where we are losing money.
testimonials.q3: The health and reproduction tracking saves us from missing important dates.

pricing.title: Simple plans for every farm size
pricing.starterDesc: For small farms starting digital management.
pricing.growthDesc: For growing farms that need full cattle, milk, health, and reproduction tracking.
pricing.enterpriseDesc: For large dairy operations needing custom setup, support, and advanced reporting.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Rakhal is a smart dairy farm management platform — it brings cattle, milk, health, reproduction, expenses, and reports into one dashboard.
faq.a2: Farm owners, managers, and workers — from small family farms to large commercial dairies.
faq.a3: Yes. Every animal gets its own profile with breed, weight, status, photos, and full history.
faq.a4: Yes. Log milk by session for every cow and see daily, weekly, and monthly production trends.
faq.q5: Can I manage health and vaccination records?
faq.a5: Yes. Report sickness, manage treatment plans, and get vaccine schedules with reminders.
faq.a6: Yes. Track heat, insemination, pregnancy checks, and calving on a full reproduction timeline.
faq.q7: Can I see profit and expense reports?
faq.a7: Yes. Record income and expenses, and download profit/loss and other reports anytime.
faq.q8: Is Rakhal suitable for small farms?
faq.a8: Absolutely. Rakhal works for farms starting from around 20 animals — with a free way to begin.
faq.a9: Yes. Invite team members with roles and permissions, so workers only see what they need.
faq.q10: Do I need technical knowledge to use Rakhal?
faq.a10: No. If you can use a smartphone, you can use Rakhal — it's Bangla-first and built for farmers.
